baseline: Exact source-free w/o Source from completed d2_ictal_ablation_seed42_v1, not historical earlier A0 or rank-zero bias-only R0
development_unit: Original65 patient-fold validation appearances from47 unique patients; equal appearance mean, secondary unique-ID mean; bootstrap47 unique IDs retaining all appearances
features: Exact original88 columns, patient_z plus stored FIT-only imputer/scaler; no masking/deduplication/new extraction
statistics: Channel mean and .5*log(population variance+original LN epsilon1e-5), computed in float64 then normalized to float32 gate inputs
stat_normalizer: FIT-only patient-equal population mean/std; each FIT patient total weight1/P, each of its channels weight1/(P*C); std floor1e-8; frozen nontrainable buffers
B1: Replace only original input LayerNorm with Identity; identical original remaining shared initialization
B2: h+ (1+q)*[Wo GELU(Wh h+bh)+bo]; q96 zero; Wo/bo zero; no magnitude-statistic input
B3: h+ Wo[ GELU(Wh h+bh)*tanh(Ws s+bs) ]+bo; Wo/bo zero; retain original Dropout/head; joint training, no pretraining or frozen backbone
optimization: Exact historical trainer with constructor adapter, source penalty0; seed42+1009*fold, AdamW lr.001 wd.0001, FIT-only NEZ-positive weighted BCE, one update per FIT patient, gradclip1, max30 min6 patience6
selection: Original validation Macro-F1/EZ-F1/earlier checkpoint; .005 threshold grid with original tie rules; each arm/fold selects own threshold

bootstrap.cluster: unique patient ID retaining validation-fold appearances

mechanism.shuffle: Within each validation patient, permute normalized2D statistics only; seed42+1009*fold; fixed checkpoints/thresholds, preserve x and h
mechanism.disable: Zero residual with trained B3 backbone; not retrained B0

conditional_outer: B3 only after all gate criteria pass and all model/scaler/threshold/code bindings freeze; compare reused B0. B1/B2 outer not authorized
